task_description: Create ChatEngine Phase 1 for SA-MP Android MonetLoader: a custom chat rendering system that intercepts all server messages via samp.events, stores them in a ring buffer, and renders them in a custom mimgui window with color parsing, category filtering, auto-hide, and configuration panel.

verification.summary: Both files validated: chatengine_lib.lua and ChatEngine.lua have correct Lua syntax, use proper MonetLoader mimgui API (PushStyleVarFloat/Vec2, PushStyleColor), have balanced Push/Pop calls (17 colors, 10 vars), correctly hook samp.events with return false, and contain no prohibited API calls. All 9 module exports verified present (including getInsertionCount).

issues_fixed: Auto-scroll saturation: added monotonic insertionCount in chatengine_lib, exposed via getInsertionCount(), ChatEngine uses it instead of getBufferSize()
Negative color integers: colorToRGBA now uses bit.band/bit.rshift for safe decomposition on LuaJIT
cfgEnabled toggle: chatInterceptEnabled reads from config at startup, saveConfig updates chatInterceptEnabled from cfgEnabled[0]
IC filter mapping: onChatMessage passes explicit 'IC' category, mapFilterToCategory maps IC to IC (not Action)
Font size slider: SetWindowFontScale(cfgFontSize[0] / 14.0) applied in chat window, reset at end
Ad category: documented as appearing only in ALL tab for Phase 1
Category detection fragility: mitigated by explicit category parameter in onChatMessage hook
